name: Char Badam

queries.query: Char Badam Bangladesh official cadastral map land records parcel DLRS
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Department of Land Records and Surveys (DLRS) official map viewer and the official Char Badam Union page. The local page places Char Badam in Ramgati Upazila, Lakshmipur District. No anonymous parcel response for this city was obtained.

queries.result: সরকারি বাংলা ফলাফলে চর বাদাম ইউনিয়ন (রামগতি, লক্ষ্মীপুর) এবং DLRS-এর অনলাইন মানচিত্র অনুসন্ধান পাওয়া গেছে। সরকারি মানচিত্র সেবার বর্তমান JavaScript অনুসরণ করে লক্ষ্মীপুর জেলার জরিপ/উপজেলা তালিকা চাওয়া হয়; উত্তর খালি ছিল, তাই কোনো দাগ পরিচয় ও জ্যামিতি যোগ্য করা যায়নি।

officialSourceAssessment.localCustodian: Char Badam Union official government page, under Lakshmipur district, identifies the local union and states that it has three mouzas; it does not publish a parcel API or geometry.
officialSourceAssessment.nationalCadastreAuthority: Department of Land Records and Surveys (DLRS), Ministry of Land, Bangladesh, evidenced by the official DLRS site and settlement.gov.bd map viewer.
officialSourceAssessment.registryBasis: A first-party local government page and the first-party national cadastral/map authority were both evidenced. This supports registryFound=true for source discovery only, not adapter qualification or citywide geometry coverage.

schemaAndCrs.inspectionNote: The viewer's current MapSearch.js exposes POST routes for division, district, survey, upazila, mouza, sheet and sheet GeoJSON retrieval. Division enumeration returned Bangladesh divisions and district enumeration returned Lakshmipur with unit code 041200000 and component code 4121. POST requests to GetSurveyListDistrictWise for Lakshmipur returned [] for the standard survey and the Diara district entry; consequently no downstream mouza/sheet or parcel response was available. No source-specific attributes were retained.
